items.text: Seahawks place rookie RB Jadarian Price on IR (chest, aggravated in practice); misses min 4 weeks. Signed Velus Jones Jr.
items.why: Official IR placement after chest aggravation.
items.implication: Longer absence; role already eroding pre-injury.
items.opportunity: Emmanuel Wilson/George Holani/Charbonnet (back practicing) for carries/GL/pass downs.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip issue; expected to play vs Eagles though snaps may be limited per speculation.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list and Schefter/McVay expect play; returned to practice.
items.implication: WR1 back in lineup; monitor snap count early.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if unrestricted; Adams/others share drop.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; full participant Friday, good to go vs Cowboys.
items.why: ETR list + Texans PR/Rapoport confirmation active.
items.implication: Elite WR restart in strong implied total and DvP.
items.opportunity: High target share vs Cowboys (worst WR DvP +7.3%).

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (ankle) for Week 4 vs Dolphins; did not practice.
items.why: ETR OUT list corroborated by Schefter full OUT report.
items.implication: Major WR downgrade; Addison primary beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison home vs soft secondary, elevated targets/routes.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) Week 4; also AD Mitchell etc.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen lead back snaps/carries; Wilson target concentration.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) for Sunday vs Rams.
items.why: Official ruling; missed practice all week.
items.implication: Eagles pass game thinned with Goedert also out.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining WRs/TEs; Brown elevated if available.

items.text: Nacua (hip) great to have back but possible snap limits; Collins (ham) excellent return spot as Cowboys inflate WR scoring most in NFL (+7.3%), Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: DvP data + implied totals; practice trends.
items.implication: Start both confidently; Collins especially smash spot.
items.opportunity: Collins high targets/routes vs soft secondary; Nacua volume if no limit.

items.text: Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson out. McConkey (foot) LP-DNP-LP trend after cracked rib. Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun vs Rams.
items.implication: Addison start/upgrade; fade or caution McConkey; fade Eagles skill if thin.
items.opportunity: Addison routes/targets spike; McConkey risk limited snaps.

items.text: Dallas Goedert OUT (with Smith and Baun) for Eagles vs Rams.
items.why: ETR comprehensive OUT list; Schefter included in players out.
items.implication: Eagles offense significantly worse without three key players.
items.opportunity: TE streamers or remaining Eagles pass-catchers; reverse prior if unexpected return.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL per prior reports); listed OUT with Caleb Douglas.
items.why: ETR list; waiver notes confirm season ACL.
items.opportunity: Ollie Gordon or other handcuffs for remaining volume.

items.text: Price tough runout: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, back-to-back fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing. Still passes eye test long-term but short-term eroded.
items.why: Snap/role splits + fumbles + injury + teammate return.
items.implication: IR seals short-term zero; monitor committee post-return.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches, RB5 util, double-digit target share, NYG allows 5.1 YPC.
items.why: Elite snap/touch share + matchup + Dowdle absence.
items.implication: Strong RB starts; top-10 upside Warren.
items.opportunity: Near-feature back roles, high volume carries/targets.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton: low util (RB27), 3.5% targets, 42% snaps, poor SEA run D (2.9 YPC). LOVE Drake London (35%+ TS w/ Penix, NO soft vs WR); LOVE Garrett Wilson (36% TS w/ Mitchell out, CHI soft).
items.why: Usage drop + tough matchup for Hampton; high TS + soft D for loves.
items.opportunity: London/Wilson target/route concentration; Hampton limited role.

items.text: LOVE Josh Downs (31% TS, RZ looks vs WAS soft slot); LOVE George Kittle (climbing share, Evans GTD, DEN soft TE). HATE Herbert (pressure + SEA elite pass D, low total); HATE Egbuka (new QB, low RZ, low total); HATE Worthy (shrinking share vs Rice); HATE Pitts (low TS w/ Penix).
items.why: Target/RZ share + matchups for loves; pressure/usage/QB change for hates.
